hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has an entry Shuadit [sdt] for an extinct allegedly Jewish variety of Provençal. But Provençal spoken by Jews has been investigated and found to be indistinguishable from non-Jewish varieties of Provençal
(**hh:ld:Pansier:Shuadit**, **hh:ld:Banitt:Shuadit**, **hh:h:GuttelAslanov:Judeo-Provencal**:560) which already have entries in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29.
